text: Traders sold Jon Ossoff overnight, pushing the blended price down 2.8 points to 23.4. Both books agreed on the direction, with Kalshi moving 3.0 points and Polymarket 2.5 points. Kalshi's market on whether El-Sayed runs at all dropped 15 points, to 13 percent, even though El-Sayed's nomination price barely moved. In the simulations Ossoff went from 18 to 16 percent of first-place finishes. Jon Ossoff leads the markets at 23, but the model likes AOC, who wins 31 percent of simulated primaries. In 10 percent of those runs nobody reaches the convention with a pledged majority. Watch the Ossoff price first when the books update tonight.
